What followed was a siege, not a campaign. The army history destroyed in Russia stayed intact and unused; the Soviet Union grew stronger every uncontested quarter; and the Anglo-American war ███████ anyway, by air and by blockade, against industry it could █████ and ███████ it could throttle. The Suez axis delivered the most complete regional victory in this campaign — and demonstrated its own ceiling, since no Mediterranean conquest touched the Atlantic or the arithmetic behind it. The fortified truce held the ███████ question at gunpoint — deterrence as permanent institution, the border war that never quite came defining a Europe armed to its median line.
